```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#load required packages:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

#load required data:
```{r}
PLFA_tidy <- read_csv("../../../TidyData/PLFA/Results/PLFA_tidy.csv")
```

#Create missing %AMF column:
```{r}
PLFA <- mutate(PLFA_tidy, PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_Percent_of_Total_Biomass = (PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_ng_g/PLFA_Total_Living_Microbial_Biomass_ng_g)*100)
```

#Write data:
```{r}
write_csv(PLFA, "Results/PLFA_Analysis_mip.csv")
```
